name: notify
description: Tells you when Claude needs you, finishes a long turn, nears a rate limit, finishes a background task or is still working: as a desktop notification (clicking it brings you to the session's tab) and, with the say mod, out loud

when.title: Alert when
when.description: away: only when you're not looking at this session (needs the ghostty mod; without it, always). always: whenever something happens

needsYou.title: Needs you
needsYou.description: Claude needs permission, asks a question, or stops on an API error. banner: a desktop notification. voice: spoken by the say mod

turnDone.title: Long turn finished
turnDone.description: A one-line summary of what a long turn did

rateLimit.title: Rate-limit warning
rateLimit.description: Once per usage window, when it passes the threshold

backgroundTasks.title: Background task finished
backgroundTasks.description: A background task Claude started has finished

checkins.title: Progress check-ins
checkins.description: During long turns, say what's in progress

summaryStyle.title: Summary style
summaryStyle.description: haiku: a one-line summary written by Claude Haiku (a tiny API call), or the tldr mod's line when it's on. first-sentence: the answer's first sentence, free

minTurnSeconds.title: Long turn (seconds)
minTurnSeconds.description: Turns shorter than this finish without an alert

checkinMinutes.title: Check-in every (minutes)
checkinMinutes.description: How often a long turn checks in

rateLimitPercent.title: Rate-limit threshold (%)
rateLimitPercent.description: Warn when a usage window passes this
